Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write Python code that streams audio chunks from an async source using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import os
import json
import asyncio
from typing import AsyncIterator, Optional

import websockets

ASSEMBLYAI_WS_URL = "wss://api.assemblyai.com/v2/realtime/ws"
ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY = os.getenv("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY")


class StreamingSpeechToText:
    def __init__(self, sample_rate: int = 16000, api_key: Optional[str] = None):
        self.sample_rate = sample_rate
        self.api_key = api_key or ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY
        if not self.api_key:
            raise ValueError("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY is required")

    async def transcribe(self, audio_chunks: AsyncIterator[bytes]) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
        params = f"?sample_rate={self.sample_rate}"
        headers = [("Authorization", self.api_key)]
        async with websockets.connect(f"{ASSEMBLYAI_WS_URL}{params}", extra_headers=headers) as ws:
            async def sender():
                async for chunk in audio_chunks:
                    if chunk:
                        await ws.send(chunk)
                await ws.send(json.dumps({"terminate_session": True}))

            send_task = asyncio.create_task(sender())
            try:
                while True:
                    message = await ws.recv()
                    data = json.loads(message)
                    if data.get("message_type") == "FinalTranscript":
                        text = data.get("text", "")
                        if text:
                            yield text
                    elif data.get("message_type") == "PartialTranscript":
                        text = data.get("text", "")
                        if text:
                            yield text
            finally:
                await send_task
